name: CT Automotive Group plc
summary: CT Automotive Group plc operates as an automotive supplier, focusing on the comprehensive process of designing, engineering, manufacturing, and supplying advanced interior components and dynamic assemblies. Their product range covers a wide array of cabin elements, including decorative trims, air vents, armrests, retractable cup holders, various storage systems, and both wrapped and mechanical assemblies. They also produce light guides, dashboard and fascia panels, and HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) doors and related systems, alongside the essential tooling required for these products. The company serves key clients in the automotive industry, specifically original equipment suppliers (OES) and tier-one manufacturers, across significant markets such as the United Kingdom, Europe, the United States, and Japan. Established in 2000, its primary corporate office is located in Portsmouth, UK.
